workflow_content:
name: Original native closed annotation import qualification

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/otzaria-native-import-closure-20261123]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: otzaria-original-closed-import-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  original-native-closed-import:
    if: github.repository == 'davidpovarsky/anytype-swift' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/otzaria-native-import-closure-20261123' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_27.app/Contents/Developer
    steps:
      - name: Fix the absolute original native execution deadline
        run: |
          echo "OTZARIA_NATIVE_IMPORT_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 6900 ))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Checkout the exact isolated source and qualification packet
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-owned-annotation-contract-20261123/bc-candidate-20261123
            docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-owned-annotation-contract-20261123/bc-native-qualification-20261123
            .github/workflows
      - name: Select actual ARM64 Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: arm64
      - name: Install the exact original Go toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          cache: false
      - name: Checkout the immutable original Heart base
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: anyproto/anytype-heart
          ref: d98420b1113536afd08cde6de9a5816f6d27ffff
          path: build/Heart-Owned-Annotation-Import
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Qualify genuine original graph import mapping body refusal and drain
        run: |
          python3 -I docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-owned-annotation-contract-20261123/bc-native-qualification-20261123/run_native_closed_import.py \
            --control-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --control-head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --execution-manifest-sha256 6598ede799ddf6a140c1d2cb90f80b32356807ddd522ec8a4b583910f7b8227f \
            --job-deadline-unix "$OTZARIA_NATIVE_IMPORT_DEADLINE" \
            --heart build/Heart-Owned-Annotation-Import \
            --work build/Heart-Owned-Annotation-Import-Work \
            --evidence build/Heart-Owned-Annotation-Import-Evidence
      - name: Retain actual native inputs results and failures without private account data
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Otzaria-Original-Owned-Annotation-Import-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/Heart-Owned-Annotation-Import-Evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 14
expected_activation: Root creates one API workflow child on source-only parent; no explicit dispatch; final whole tree must equal prepared_tree.
